name: indx_carve
description: Recover file names a directory no longer lists. Parses INDX blocks ($INDEX_ALLOCATION, the $I30 stream) and, past the end of the live entries, carves the slack where entries for deleted files survive with their $FILE_NAME times and sizes. Also sweeps a raw blob for INDX blocks.

path.description: An extracted $I30 / $INDEX_ALLOCATION stream, or a raw blob to sweep

slack_only.description: Return only entries carved from slack: the ones the directory no longer lists

name.description: Case-insensitive regex over the recovered names

limit.description: Entries shown inline (default 500); every block is read, and when more entries match the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results
